description_en: Queries the scan tasks of a specified scan target for AI Red Teaming with paging, and supports filtering by detection intensity, task status, and scan mode
description_zh: AI Red Teaming，分页查询指定扫描目标下的扫描任务，支持按检测强度、任务状态与扫描模式过滤
name: ListScanTasksByTarget

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the scan target. Only tasks under this target are queried. If the target does not exist or does not belong to the current tenant, a 400 error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 扫描目标的唯一标识，仅查询该目标下的任务；目标不存在或不归属当前租户时返回 400
parameters.name: target_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100. If the value is greater than 100, it is clamped to 100. If the value is less than 1, a 400 error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 每页条数，默认 10，单页上限 100；大于 100 时钳制为 100，小于 1 时返回 400
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. If the value is less than 1, it is normalized to 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从 1 开始；小于 1 时归一为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: Filters tasks by detection intensity. If this parameter is not specified, tasks are not filtered by intensity
parameters.help_zh: 按检测强度过滤；不传则不按强度过滤
parameters.name: sample_level

parameters.help_en: Filters tasks by task status. If this parameter is not specified, tasks of all statuses are returned
parameters.help_zh: 按任务状态过滤；不传返回全部状态
parameters.name: task_status

parameters.help_en: Filters tasks by scan mode. If this parameter is not specified, tasks of all modes are returned
parameters.help_zh: 按扫描模式过滤；不传返回全部模式
parameters.name: scan_type

Data.description_en: The list of scan tasks on the current page
Data.description_zh: 当前页的扫描任务列表

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the task. The value is a millisecond timestamp (Unix epoch in milliseconds)
CreateTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间，毫秒时间戳（Unix epoch 毫秒）

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the task. The value is a millisecond timestamp (Unix epoch in milliseconds). If the task has not ended, the value is null
EndTime.description_zh: 任务结束时间，毫秒时间戳（Unix epoch 毫秒）；任务未结束时为 null

ExecuteCaseCount.description_en: The number of samples that have been executed for the task
ExecuteCaseCount.description_zh: 任务已执行的样本数量

RiskLevel.description_en: The risk level of the task result. If the task is not completed or no risk assessment is generated, the value is null
RiskLevel.description_zh: 任务结果的风险等级；任务未完成或未产生风险评定时为 null

SampleLevel.description_en: The detection intensity of the task

ScanType.description_en: The scan mode of the task. For historical tasks that do not have a recorded scan mode, the value is normalized to attack
ScanType.description_zh: 任务的扫描模式；历史未记录扫描模式的任务归一为 attack

ScannerTaskId.description_en: The unique identifier of the scan task. It can be used to download results and track status
ScannerTaskId.description_zh: 扫描任务的唯一标识，可用于结果下载与状态跟踪

ScannerTaskMessage.description_en: The task message. If the task fails, this parameter indicates the cause of the failure. If the task succeeds or no message is available, this parameter is empty
ScannerTaskMessage.description_zh: 任务消息；失败时为失败原因，成功或无消息时为空

ScannerTaskStatus.description_en: The current status of the task

ScannerType.description_en: The actual execution mode used by the scan task, which is obtained from the scannerType field of the task. classic indicates the sample mode. agent indicates the autonomous multi-round attack mode of the agent. executor is a historical compatibility value, which is equivalent to classic
ScannerType.description_zh: 该扫描任务实际使用的执行模式，取自任务的 scannerType 字段。classic 表示样本模式；agent 表示 Agent 自主多轮攻击模式；executor 为历史兼容值，等同于 classic

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the task. The value is a millisecond timestamp (Unix epoch in milliseconds). If the task has not started, the value is null
StartTime.description_zh: 任务开始时间，毫秒时间戳（Unix epoch 毫秒）；任务未开始时为 null

TaskName.description_en: The name of the task. If no name is specified during creation, the default value is Target Scan - target name
TaskName.description_zh: 任务名称；创建时未指定则默认为"Target Scan - 目标名称"
TaskName.example: Target Scan - 我的百炼靶标

TotalCaseCount.description_en: The total number of samples planned to be executed for the task
TotalCaseCount.description_zh: 任务计划执行的样本总数

PageNumber.description_en: The actual effective page number after normalization. This value may not be equal to the input parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 归一化后的实际生效页码，不一定等于入参

PageSize.description_en: The actual effective number of entries per page after normalization. This value may not be equal to the input parameter
PageSize.description_zh: 归一化后的实际生效每页条数，不一定等于入参

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. It is used for troubleshooting and log tracing
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于问题排查与日志追踪

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of scan tasks that meet the filter conditions within the last 366 days
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足过滤条件的扫描任务总数（最近 366 天窗口内）
